title.id: Readable UI, Bahasa, dan Component Intelligence
title.en: Readable UI, Language, and Component Intelligence

id: Comfort UI menjadi default: teks, tombol, tab, inspector, library, simulator, dan chat diperbesar agar tidak membuat mata cepat lelah.
Tambah pilihan Bahasa Indonesia / English yang tersimpan di browser.
Tambah kontrol ukuran antarmuka dan kontras yang lebih nyaman.
Tambah Component Intelligence: status model, capability, limit, package/variant warning, dan confidence untuk komponen yang dipilih.
Tambah Patch Updates di dalam aplikasi agar setiap perkembangan terlihat jelas.
Sumber komponen spesifik mulai dikunci ke referensi vendor; entri generik tidak lagi dianggap mempunyai rating pasti tanpa MPN/datasheet.
en: Comfort UI is now the default: larger text, controls, tabs, inspector, library, simulator, and assistant chat.
Added persistent Indonesian / English language selection.
Added UI size controls and a more comfortable contrast profile.
Added Component Intelligence: model status, capabilities, limits, package/variant warnings, and confidence for the selected part.
Added in-app Patch Updates so product progress is visible on every release.
Specific parts begin using vendor-grounded references; generic entries are no longer treated as having exact ratings without an MPN/datasheet.

id: Pointer Events + requestAnimationFrame untuk drag yang lebih ringan.
Panel resize, pan/zoom, undo/redo, dan placement yang lebih fleksibel.
en: Pointer Events + requestAnimationFrame for smoother movement.
Resizable panels, pan/zoom, undo/redo, and more flexible placement.

id: Monte Carlo, tolerance, electro-thermal iteration, source/trace droop, dan fault injection.
Field envelope menggantikan angka simulasi ideal tunggal.
en: Monte Carlo, tolerance, electro-thermal iteration, source/trace droop, and fault injection.
Field envelopes replace single idealized simulation numbers.

id: Asisten membaca project aktif, melakukan audit, mengubah nilai, menambah part, membuka workspace, dan menjalankan Reality Lab.
en: Assistant reads the active project, audits it, changes values, adds parts, switches workspaces, and runs Reality Lab.
